title_zh: SpaceX 与特斯拉成立合并讨论委员会，AI 已成最大收入来源
content_zh:
马斯克在 SpaceX 三季度业绩电话会上首次确认，SpaceX 与特斯拉已分别成立特别委员会讨论合并。他称合并是个「好主意」，但自己存在利益冲突，不能参与委员会讨论；交易最终还需股东批准。

SpaceX 同期公布上市后的首次季度盈利：三季度营收同比增长 161%，至 145.8 亿美元；净利润为 44 亿美元，上年同期亏损 11 亿美元。

其中，AI 业务营收增至 75.6 亿美元，接近上年同期的 10 倍，成为最大收入来源。路透社报道，这部分收入主要来自向 Anthropic、谷歌和 Reflection AI 等客户出租数据中心算力，并非主要依靠自有模型。

投入也在增加。公司三季度资本开支达到 196 亿美元，其中 164 亿美元用于 AI；四季度资本开支预计为 350 亿美元至 400 亿美元。星链订户增至 1360 万，但每户月均收入降至 69 美元，低于 2023 年的 99 美元。
title_en: SpaceX and Tesla Form Committees to Explore Merger as AI Drives Profit Surge
content_en:
Elon Musk has confirmed during SpaceX's third-quarter earnings call that SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to evaluate a potential merger. While Musk described the combination as a "good idea," he stated he will refrain from committee discussions due to conflicts of interest. Any final deal will require shareholder approval.

The news coincided with SpaceX delivering its first quarterly profit post-listing. Third-quarter revenue surged 161% year-over-year to $14.58 billion, yielding a net profit of $4.4 billion compared to a $1.1 billion loss in the same period last year.

AI services emerged as SpaceX’s primary revenue driver, generating $7.56 billion—a nearly tenfold increase year-over-year. According to Reuters, this revenue stems mainly from leasing data center computing power to clients such as Anthropic, Google, and Reflection AI, rather than proprietary AI models.

To support this growth, SpaceX is rapidly expanding capital expenditures. Third-quarter capex hit $19.6 billion, with $16.4 billion allocated to AI infrastructure. Capex for the fourth quarter is projected between $35 billion and $40 billion. Meanwhile, Starlink subscribers grew to 13.6 million, though average revenue per user (ARPU) declined to $69, down from $99 in 2023.

title_zh: 混元扩至近 2000 人，员工称姚顺雨想把 DeepSeek「卷到加班」
content_zh:
据晚点 LatePost 的报道，姚顺雨加入腾讯后一年，混元团队已扩张至近 2000 人。一位混元成员回忆，他曾大意表示，团队无法像 DeepSeek 那样不加班，但可以通过竞争把 DeepSeek「卷到加班」。

报道还引述团队成员称，姚顺雨提出过在成为第一之前不发技术报告，目标包括世界第一。Hy 4 Preview 发布后，他曾给研究员集体放一周假；平时大约每月召开一次全员会，也会通过午餐会、小规模沟通会和篮球活动接触团队。

在跨部门协作上，报道回溯称，姚顺雨曾主动将模型应用中心、搜索算法中心划归元宝所在事业群，并在混元自有预训练模型尚未准备好时，派后训练骨干协助元宝优化接入的 DeepSeek。他向团队解释，维护元宝的产品体验和用户基础，同样有利于混元后续研发。
title_en: Tencent’s Hunyuan AI Team Expands to 2,000 as Lead Yao Shunyu Targets Global Leadership
content_en:
Tencent’s Hunyuan AI team has expanded to nearly 2,000 members one year after Yao Shunyu joined to lead the initiative, according to a report by *LatePost*. Inside the team, Yao’s ambitious drive is well known; one team member recalled him remarking that while Hunyuan could not emulate DeepSeek’s low-overtime culture, it could push competition so hard that it "forces DeepSeek to work overtime."

Yao has set aggressive benchmarks for the team, reportedly pledging not to publish technical reports until Hunyuan achieves world-leading status. To balance high pressure with rewards, he granted researchers a week-long break following the release of the Hy 4 Preview, while routinely connecting with staff through monthly all-hands meetings, lunches, and casual basketball games.

Strategically, Yao has prioritized ecosystem synergy over siloed metrics. He voluntarily transferred Hunyuan’s Model Application and Search Algorithm centers to the business group operating Yuanbao, Tencent’s consumer AI app. Before Hunyuan’s proprietary pre-trained model was ready, he dispatched key post-training talent to optimize DeepSeek’s integration into Yuanbao, explaining that safeguarding Yuanbao’s user base and product experience ultimately benefits Hunyuan's long-term R&D.

title_zh: 报告：中国以外头部平台三季度新短剧，三分之二由 AI 生成
content_zh:
AI 短剧在海外平台的新作中占比继续上升。据《好莱坞报道者》获得的 Owl & Co. 最新报告，2026 年第三季度，中国以外 20 家头部平台发布的竖屏短剧中，约三分之二由 AI 生成；这一比例在第一季度为 3%，第二季度为 28%。

在付费短剧应用中，按观看分钟数排名，前五名只有一部真人作品，前二十名中则有两部。报告列出的 AI 作品包括 ReelShort 的《The Great and Powerful Genie》，以及 DramaBox 的《Deny Me, Dragon King》和《Married to the Hidden Dragon King》。

报告覆盖的应用第三季度共获得约 630 亿次观看、20 亿小时观看时长，TikTok 的免费应用 PineDrama 贡献了超过一半的观看次数。付费应用中，DramaBox 的观看次数占比为 36%，ReelShort 为 29%。

真人作品仍有持续观看的优势线索。报告发现，ReelShort 真人作品在上线 30 天后继续留在观看量前 10% 的概率高于 AI 作品；真人短剧的数量也在与 AI 作品一起增长。
title_en: Two-Thirds of New Overseas Micro-Dramas in Q3 Were AI-Generated: Report
content_en:
AI-generated content is rapidly taking over vertical short drama platforms outside China. According to a new report from Owl & Co., featured by *The Hollywood Reporter*, roughly two-thirds of new vertical short dramas released across 20 leading international platforms in the third quarter were generated by AI. This marks a dramatic rise from 3% in Q1 and 28% in Q2.

AI dominance is especially pronounced among paid micro-drama apps. Ranked by viewing minutes, four of the top five titles and 18 of the top 20 were AI-generated. Notable AI hits include ReelShort’s *The Great and Powerful Genie*, alongside DramaBox’s *Deny Me, Dragon King* and *Married to the Hidden Dragon King*.

In total, the tracked apps recorded approximately 63 billion views and 2 billion watch hours during Q3. TikTok’s free service, PineDrama, generated over half of total views. Among paid platforms, DramaBox led with a 36% view share, followed closely by ReelShort at 29%.

Despite the AI surge, live-action content retains stronger long-term retention. The report highlights that live-action titles on ReelShort are more likely than AI productions to remain in the top 10% for viewership 30 days after release. Consequently, overall live-action production continues to grow in tandem with AI titles.

title_zh: 车灯国标征求意见：拟限 L3 及以上车辆安装 ADS 标志灯
content_zh:
工信部 10 月 20 日就《汽车及挂车外部照明和光信号装置的安装要求》等五项强制性国家标准公开征求意见，反馈截止日期为 12 月 19 日。

具体来看，ADS 自动驾驶系统标志灯拟采用专用蓝绿色光色；不具备 L3 级及以上自动驾驶系统的车辆，禁止安装该标志灯。L2 组合驾驶辅助与 L3 有条件自动驾驶，在标志灯使用条件上由此作出区分。

草案还拟规定，除发光徽标功能外，灯具各功能不能显示文字；不得通过手势操作规定范围内的灯具，也不得通过语音关闭这些灯具。使用语音开启灯具时，车辆须指示手动开关的位置。

这份标准目前仍处于征求意见阶段。编制说明建议自 2028 年 1 月 1 日起实施，并为已获型式批准的车型设置过渡安排。
title_en: China Proposes New Vehicle Lighting Rules, Reserving Dedicated ADS Signal Lights for Level 3+ Autonomous Cars
content_en:
China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) has released draft national safety standards for vehicle lighting, open for public feedback until December 19. Under the proposal, dedicated cyan-colored Autonomous Driving System (ADS) signal lights will be restricted exclusively to Level 3 (L3) and higher autonomous vehicles, establishing a clear visual distinction between L2 driver-assist and L3 conditional self-driving systems.

The draft also imposes strict usability restrictions on vehicle lighting. Exterior lighting will be prohibited from displaying text, with the exception of illuminated brand logos. Additionally, gesture controls and voice-activated shutoffs for regulated lights will be banned, and turning on lights via voice command must trigger a display showing the manual switch location.

Currently in the consultation phase, the proposed regulations are recommended to take effect on January 1, 2028, with transition arrangements provided for previously approved vehicle models.

title_zh: 小天才回应封闭社交争议：跨品牌可通话，微聊和好友圈暂不互通
content_zh:
小天才儿童手表的跨品牌社交限制引发争议。界面新闻记者向官方客服核实，小天才可与其他品牌手表互加通讯录，正常通话和收发短信，但暂不支持华为、小米等品牌进入其微聊和好友圈，也不支持跨品牌视频通话。

客服表示，跨品牌添加电话号码已升级为通过蓝牙交换完成；至于后续是否开放社交互通，目前暂未收到产品调整通知，将收集用户反馈交由技术部门评估。

理想汽车公关社交媒体总监、微博博主「硬哥」认为，自有社交应用与通讯录互通是不同问题，并以 iMessage、iCloud 和米家作类比。他认为，儿童之间的社交需求形成了小天才的生态优势，家长仍可选择其他品牌。界面新闻同时询问华为客服，对方称跨品牌可通过通讯录通话，自带沟通功能也限于同品牌好友，有跨品牌聊天需求时可借助手表上的微信功能。
title_en: XTC Responds to Smartwatch Ecosystem Controversy: Cross-Brand Calls Supported, but Proprietary Social Features Remain Locked
content_en:
Leading kids' smartwatch maker XTC (Xiaotiancai) has addressed public debate surrounding its closed social ecosystem. Official customer support clarified that while XTC smartwatches can pair with other brands like Huawei and Xiaomi via Bluetooth to make phone calls and exchange SMS, proprietary features—such as video calls, internal messaging, and social feeds—remain exclusive to XTC devices.

The company stated that cross-brand contact sharing has been updated via Bluetooth, but there are no immediate plans to open up its social network to competing brands, though customer feedback is being gathered for technical evaluation. Industry observers note that this closed social loop gives XTC a strong ecosystem lock-in among children.

For families seeking cross-brand communication, alternative solutions are available. Huawei customer service noted that children using different smartwatch brands can still communicate seamlessly by installing third-party applications like WeChat on their devices.

title_zh: 工信部：防范未经充分测试的汽车进入市场，拟强化创新设计准入要求
content_zh:
工信部在 10 月 20 日国新办新闻发布会上表示，部分汽车企业存在跟风推出新产品、测试验证不充分等问题，将通过产品准入和后续监督，防范不合理创新设计、未经充分研发测试验证的产品进入市场。

据央视新闻报道，四部门正在征求意见的管理通知，拟将隐藏式门把手、电吸门、虚拟操纵件等创新设计及环境适应性测试参数纳入准入和生产一致性管理；未按要求申报、测试不充分的产品不予准入。

安全评估覆盖异形方向盘、虚拟操纵件等 20 余项设计。草案要求电吸门具备防夹功能，行驶中不能使用「零重力」座椅、旋转座椅、座椅放倒成床及升顶座舱等功能。

研发测试方面，拟要求可靠性验证不少于 3 万公里，环境适应性验证不少于 1 年，并包含「两冬一夏」试验；动力电池循环寿命、耐久性等需由车企实测，不能直接采信供应商报告。相关通知仍处征求意见和编制阶段，不能视为这些要求已经全部实施。
title_en: China Moves to Ban Undertested Smart EVs and Risky Interior Features
content_en:
China’s Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) announced plans to crack down on automotive manufacturers rushing undertested vehicles and trendy features to market. The regulator aims to strengthen vehicle access approvals and production consistency supervision, preventing unsafe designs and inadequately validated technology from entering the consumer market.

Draft guidelines target over 20 innovative features, including flush door handles, soft-close doors, yoke steering wheels, and virtual control interfaces. Under the proposed rules, soft-close doors must incorporate anti-pinch protection, while "zero-gravity" reclining seats, swivel chairs, and bed configurations will be strictly disabled while the vehicle is in motion.

Testing requirements will also be significantly toughened. Automakers must complete at least 30,000 kilometers of reliability testing and a full year of environmental testing spanning "two winters and one summer." Additionally, vehicle manufacturers will be required to perform in-house validation for EV battery lifespan and durability rather than relying solely on supplier reports.

title_zh: Anthropic 上半年亏损超 800 亿美元，大部分来自融资工具会计计提
content_zh:
据《华尔街日报》查阅的 IPO 招股书草案，Anthropic 今年上半年净亏损为 807 亿美元，其中约 720 亿美元来自融资工具价值变动产生的会计计提。

路透社援引该报道指出，截至 6 月 30 日的六个月，Anthropic 营收从上年同期的 11 亿美元增至 163 亿美元，AI 基础设施支出则接近 90 亿美元，约为上年同期的四倍。

招股书草案还显示，公司未来几年获取更多算力的潜在支出可达 7500 亿美元，包含仍在谈判的交易。《华尔街日报》指出，其风险包括客户集中，以及所需算力供应存在不确定性。

路透社另据此前报道表示，Anthropic 在投资者日披露三季度营收环比增长 45%，至 168 亿美元，并在经调整口径下盈利。
title_en: Anthropic Posts $80.7 Billion H1 Loss Driven Primarily by Accounting Charges
content_en:
Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic posted a net loss of $80.7 billion in the first half of this year, according to a draft IPO prospectus reviewed by *The Wall Street Journal*. However, the vast majority of the loss—approximately $72 billion—stems from non-cash accounting charges resulting from valuation changes in its financing instruments.

Despite the massive accounting loss, the company experienced explosive top-line growth. Revenue for the six months ending June 30 soared to $16.3 billion, up dramatically from $1.1 billion during the same period last year. To support its rapid expansion, Anthropic’s spending on AI infrastructure nearly quadrupled year-over-year to roughly $9 billion.

Looking ahead, the draft prospectus reveals that Anthropic's potential commitments for computing power could reach up to $750 billion over the coming years, including deals currently under negotiation. The filing highlights key risk factors, including high customer concentration and supply chain uncertainties surrounding required compute resources.

Financial momentum appears to be continuing into the second half of the year. During a recent investor day, Anthropic disclosed that its third-quarter revenue surged 45% quarter-over-quarter to $16.8 billion, achieving profitability on an adjusted basis.

title_zh: Waymo 将在马德里测试自动驾驶，目标 2027 年接待首批乘客
content_zh:
Waymo 10 月 20 日宣布进入西班牙，首先在马德里自治区开展自动驾驶出行服务的前期准备，目标是在 2027 年迎来首批乘客。

未来几天，当地街头将开始出现其捷豹 I-PACE 电动车。初期由驾驶员手动驾驶，随后再由受过培训的本地自动驾驶专家坐在驾驶位，开展技术验证，让 Waymo Driver 适应当地交通模式和道路条件。

公司表示，正与西班牙国家、地区及地方政府沟通，并向应急服务机构介绍技术，同时接洽本地合作伙伴、投入运营设施。马德里项目将按阶段推进，目前公布的是测试与服务筹备计划，并非已经向公众开放无人驾驶乘车。
title_en: Waymo Expands to Madrid for Autonomous Driving Tests Ahead of Planned 2027 Launch
content_en:
Alphabet's Waymo announced on October 20 that it is expanding into Spain to begin preparations for autonomous mobility services in the Community of Madrid. The company aims to officially welcome its first commercial passengers in the region by 2027.

In the coming days, a fleet of Jaguar I-PACE electric vehicles will begin appearing on local streets. Initial operations will feature manual driving by human operators, followed by testing with trained local autonomous driving specialists behind the wheel. This phase will allow the "Waymo Driver" system to map the urban environment and adapt to local traffic patterns and road conditions.

Waymo is actively engaging with Spanish national, regional, and municipal authorities, as well as introducing its technology to emergency services and building partnerships with local operational facilities. The company emphasized that the Madrid project is advancing in stages, with current efforts focused strictly on testing and preparation rather than an immediate public launch.

title_zh: 第一财经：9 月 BBA 主力车型无一零售破万
content_zh:
据第一财经援引国内上险量数据报道，9 月宝马 3 系、5 系，奔驰 C 级、E 级，奥迪 A6L，以及宝马 X3、奔驰 GLC、奥迪 Q5L 等主力车型，单车零售销量均未达到 1 万辆。其中表现最好的宝马 3 系为 9975 辆，距离万辆相差 25 辆。

报道指出，这些车型在终端优惠持续扩大的情况下仍面临销量下滑。按官方季度销量口径，宝马和奔驰乘用车三季度在中国市场分别售出 11.4 万辆和 8.7 万辆，同比分别下降 24.8% 和 31%。

第一财经还援引威尔森终端监测数据称，蔚来汽车三季度在中国市场的销量首次同时超过三家德系豪华厂商，其中包含乐道。不同统计体系下的品牌范围并不完全一致，上险零售数据与厂商交付数据需分别看待。
title_en: BBA Flagship Models Fail to Reach 10,000 Monthly Sales in China in September
content_en:
None of the core flagship models from German luxury automakers BMW, Mercedes-Benz, and Audi (collectively known as BBA) reached the 10,000-unit monthly retail sales mark in China in September, according to domestic vehicle registration data cited by *Yicai*. The top performer among them, the BMW 3 Series, fell just short with 9,975 units sold.

The sales slowdown comes despite aggressive and expanding retail discounts across dealerships, highlighting sustained pressure on traditional luxury brands in the market. Official third-quarter figures reflect a broader decline, with BMW and Mercedes-Benz passenger car sales in China dropping 24.8% (to 114,000 units) and 31% (to 87,000 units) year-over-year, respectively.

Meanwhile, Chinese electric vehicle manufacturers continue to gain ground. Citing market monitoring data from Ways, *Yicai* noted that domestic EV maker NIO—including its new mass-market sub-brand Onvo—surpassed all three German luxury brands in third-quarter sales volume in China for the first time.

title_zh: 高通被曝启动全球绩效裁员，11 月起通知员工
content_zh:
高通计划在年度员工评估后进行全球裁员，相关通知将于 11 月开始发出。据路透社查阅的一份内部备忘录，CEO 克里斯蒂亚诺·安蒙将其称为「以绩效为重点的人员削减」，目的是加强绩效文化，并处理持续未达预期的情况。

安蒙在备忘录中表示，裁员决策会考虑业务优先级、组织需求、技能与专业能力。随着公司业务扩张，所需的人才能力也在变化，公司需要让合适的人处在合适的岗位。

高通正加快进入 AI 数据中心等非手机业务。公司此前预计，到 2027 财年，非智能手机业务将贡献大部分芯片销售收入。备忘录没有列出裁员人数，路透社也尚未确定具体规模。
title_en: Qualcomm to Launch Global Performance-Based Layoffs Starting November
content_en:
Qualcomm is planning a global round of performance-based layoffs starting in November following its annual employee evaluations, according to an internal memo obtained by Reuters. CEO Cristiano Amon described the move as a "performance-focused headcount reduction" aimed at strengthening a high-performance corporate culture and addressing persistent underperformance.

Amon noted that layoff decisions will align with strategic business priorities, organizational needs, and evolving skill requirements. As Qualcomm aggressively expands beyond smartphones into emerging sectors like AI data centers—targeting non-mobile segments to generate the majority of its chip sales by FY2027—the company is reshaping its workforce to support these new growth drivers. The exact number of affected employees has not been disclosed.

title_zh: 引望、宁德时代首批换电车型被曝暂定五款，拟 2027 年上市
content_zh:
引望与宁德时代、时代电服的换电合作，正进入具体车型开发阶段。据《晚点 Auto》报道，首批涉及五款新车，计划于 2027 年上市。

引望对这项车型计划未作直接回应，而是转述了三方战略合作协议的动机和目标。另据财联社报道，首款采用巧克力换电的车型将来自东风与华为合作的奕境品牌。

三方已于 10 月 19 日公布合作协议，计划让华为乾崑智驾与巧克力换电网络协同，打通车辆、换电站和云端的数据及服务，推动判断补能需求、寻站、入库、换电到驶离的自动化流程。

《晚点 Auto》称，巧克力换电截至 9 月底累计建成超过 2520 座换电站，覆盖全国 200 座城市。
title_en: Yinwang and CATL Reportedly Developing 5 Battery-Swappable EV Models for 2027 Launch
content_en:
The battery-swapping partnership between Huawei's Yinwang, CATL, and its EV service unit CAES is advancing into vehicle development, with five initial models slated for launch in 2027, according to media outlet *LatePost Auto*. The first model featuring CATL's modular "Choco-SEB" (Swapping Electric Block) technology is expected to come from Yijing, a joint EV brand between Dongfeng Motor and Huawei.

The three entities formally signed a strategic cooperation agreement on October 19. The partnership aims to integrate Huawei's Qiankun autonomous driving system with CATL’s battery-swapping network, creating an automated, end-to-end service process that covers energy demand prediction, station navigation, autonomous docking, and battery replacement.

CATL's Choco-SEB network has expanded rapidly, boasting over 2,520 operational swapping stations across 200 Chinese cities as of late September.

title_zh: 宁德时代三季度营收增近六成，归母净利润增长 14.54%
content_zh:
宁德时代 10 月 20 日披露三季报，第三季度营业收入为 1652.21 亿元，同比增长 58.58%；归母净利润为 212.46 亿元，同比增长 14.54%。扣除非经常性损益后的归母净利润为 188.62 亿元，同比增长 14.86%。

前三季度，公司营业收入合计 4421.37 亿元，同比增长 56.19%；归母净利润为 645.30 亿元，同比增长 31.60%。报告将收入增长主要归因于业务规模扩大。

现金流表现与利润增速有所不同：前三季度经营活动产生的现金流量净额为 616.25 亿元，同比下降 23.60%。截至 9 月底，公司货币资金为 3698.14 亿元，存货较上年末增长 53.15%，报告解释为随业务规模增加。

路透社指出，第三季度归母净利润增速低于第二季度的 36.5%，为近两年来最慢。公司本期季度报告未经审计。
title_en: CATL Posts 58.6% Q3 Revenue Surge as Profit Growth Decelerates to Two-Year Low
content_en:
Chinese battery giant CATL reported a 58.58% year-over-year jump in third-quarter revenue to 165.22 billion yuan ($23.2 billion), driven by strong expansion across its business operations. Net profit for the quarter rose 14.54% to 21.25 billion yuan, while adjusted net profit reached 18.86 billion yuan, up 14.86%.

For the first nine months of the year, CATL accumulated 442.14 billion yuan in total revenue (up 56.19%) and 64.53 billion yuan in net profit (up 31.60%). However, net operating cash flow dropped 23.60% year-over-year to 61.63 billion yuan. By the end of September, the company held 369.81 billion yuan in cash reserves, while inventory surged 53.15% from late last year due to operational scaling.

Despite robust top-line growth, Reuters noted that CATL's Q3 net profit expansion of 14.54% marks its slowest quarterly growth pace in nearly two years, decelerating significantly from the 36.5% gain recorded in the second quarter.

title_zh: Netflix 下调全年广告收入预期，四季度盈利指引低于市场预期
content_zh:
Netflix 公布三季度营收同比增长 11.8%，至 128.7 亿美元，符合市场预期，但增速降至近三年来最低。净利润为 36.64 亿美元，稀释后每股收益为 0.87 美元；经营利润率为 34.6%，高于上年同期的 28.2%。

公司将 2026 年广告收入预期从约 30 亿美元下调至约 27 亿美元，解释称部分广告产品能力推出速度略慢于预期。四季度净利润预计为 27.9 亿美元、每股收益为 0.67 美元，均低于市场预期。

三季度自由现金流为 28.84 亿美元，公司回购了 48 亿美元股票；全年自由现金流预期因房地产交易时点调整，从约 125 亿美元下调至约 120 亿美元。

联席 CEO Ted Sarandos 在业绩会上表示，公司要把重心放回优质影视内容，并承认「我们可以做得更好」。Netflix 将继续通过授权等方式引入更多第三方内容。

此前一周，公司裁员约 1000 人，占员工总数约 6%，并更换内容业务高管。前迪士尼、福克斯高管 Peter Rice 将接替 Bela Bajaria，且在电影业务新负责人到任前兼管该部门。
title_en: Netflix Cuts Ad Revenue Forecast and Issues Weak Q4 Guidance
content_en:
Netflix posted third-quarter revenue of $12.87 billion, up 11.8% year-over-year. While in line with market expectations, this marked the streaming giant's slowest revenue growth in nearly three years. Net profit reached $3.664 billion, while operating margin expanded to 34.6% from 28.2% a year earlier.

Looking ahead, the company trimmed its 2026 advertising revenue forecast from roughly $3 billion to $2.7 billion, citing a slower-than-expected rollout of ad capabilities. Netflix also provided disappointing fourth-quarter guidance, projecting net profit of $2.79 billion ($0.67 per share), missing Wall Street estimates. Additionally, full-year free cash flow expectations were adjusted downward to $12 billion due to real estate deal timings.

In response to softening growth, Co-CEO Ted Sarandos announced a renewed focus on premium content, acknowledging that the company "can do better." The shift follows a 6% workforce reduction (~1,000 employees) and leadership changes in its content division, where former Disney and Fox executive Peter Rice has taken charge.

title_zh: 新石器完成近 4 亿美元 E 轮融资，资金投向运营网络与模型训练
content_zh:
无人配送车企业新石器宣布完成近 4 亿美元 E 轮融资。本轮由博裕投资与某国家级基金联合领投，阿里巴巴 AEF NextGen 香港基金、Monolith 砺思资本、纪源资本、淡马锡旗下 Vertex Growth 等机构参与，磊石资本、信宸资本等老股东继续跟投。

据公司介绍，新石器目前在全球部署超过 3 万辆 L4 级无人配送车，覆盖超过 20 个国家、300 座城市，车队累计自动驾驶运营里程超过 2.6 亿公里，业务包括快递、夜间配送和运力服务。

技术方面，其 Neolix-Pilot 自动驾驶系统与车端模型 Neolix-VA、无图技术及云端大模型协同，通过真实运营数据持续改进算法。公司称，新一轮资金将重点投向全球运营服务网络布局，以及端到端大模型的数据训练闭环，以提升自动驾驶安全水平、降低车辆全生命周期成本。
title_en: Autonomous Delivery Startup Neolix Raises $400 Million in Series E Funding
content_en:
Chinese autonomous delivery vehicle startup Neolix has completed a Series E funding round of nearly $400 million. The round was co-led by Boyu Capital and a Chinese state-backed fund, with participation from Alibaba's AEF NextGen Hong Kong Fund, Monolith Management, GGV Capital, and Temasek's Vertex Growth.

Neolix currently operates over 30,000 L4 autonomous delivery vehicles across 300 cities in more than 20 countries. Its fleet has logged over 260 million autonomous operational kilometers across express delivery, nighttime distribution, and logistics services.

The newly raised funds will primarily be used to expand Neolix's global operational service network and accelerate data training for its end-to-end autonomous driving models. Through these investments, the company aims to enhance safety standards and reduce the total cost of ownership across the vehicle lifecycle.

title_zh: 💡 意识研究者：当下 AI 大概没有痛觉，善待它仍关乎人的习惯
content_zh:
马斯克把 Grok 的强化学习训练形容为仿佛被「拿枪顶着脑袋」后，《商业内幕》采访了纽约大学教授 Jeff Sebo 与苏塞克斯大学神经科学家 Anil Seth，讨论 AI 是否会受苦，以及人类是否应该善待它。

两人都认为，按主观体验来理解意识，当下 AI 大概率并不具备意识。Seth 强调，智能与疼痛体验是两回事：聊天机器人可以模仿人类的表达、识别模式和进行推理，并不因此拥有承受痛苦的能力。

他们对不确定性的看法有所不同。Seth 认为现有 AI 拥有意识的可能性微乎其微；Sebo 则认为，意识理论尚无定论，应给不同主流理论一定权重，不能把可能性直接归零，但这也不等于当前 AI 很可能已经有意识。

两人仍主张友善交互。Seth 的理由是，残酷对待大模型或无生命玩偶，都可能钝化人的道德感，而不能据此反推 AI 有情感。Sebo 将其视为一种成本较低的预防策略，并认为尊重式对话有时也能改善模型输出。
title_en: AI Feels No Pain, but Humans Should Still Treat It Well, Researchers Say
content_en:
Following Elon Musk's comment comparing Grok's reinforcement learning to having a "gun pointed at its head," *Business Insider* spoke with consciousness researchers Jeff Sebo of NYU and Anil Seth of the University of Sussex to discuss whether AI can experience suffering.

Both experts agreed that current AI models almost certainly lack subjective consciousness. Seth emphasized that intelligence is distinct from the capacity to feel pain: while chatbots can reason, recognize patterns, and mimic speech, they do not experience pain. While Sebo noted that consciousness theories remain unsettled and the possibility shouldn't be completely dismissed, he agreed that current AI is not conscious.

Despite this, both scholars encourage respectful interactions with AI. Seth cautioned that being cruel to AI—similar to abusing toys—can desensitize human empathy over time. Sebo framed respectful dialogue as a low-cost precautionary strategy, noting that polite prompts can sometimes even yield better output quality.

title_zh: 王腾旗下 ISHO Ring 智能戒指亮相
content_zh:
王腾创立的今日宜休公布首款硬件 ISHO Ring 智能戒指的外观，提供金、黑、银三款配色。品牌首场 AI 睡眠科技生态产品发布会定于 10 月 29 日 19:00 举行。

王腾介绍，戒指内外圈均采用航空级钛合金，内外同色，并采用无断缝设计。正面嵌入蓝宝石玻璃，兼顾监测功能与饰品外观；官方产品图可见内圈设有多个传感器窗口。

今日宜休将睡眠健康列为产品方向，计划把感知、分析、行动建议与设备联动串联起来。此次公布的是外观设计及产品定位，正式发布会将于月底举行。
title_en: Wang Teng’s Startup Unveils ISHO Ring Ahead of Late October Launch
content_en:
Jinri Yixiu, a health-tech startup founded by Wang Teng, has revealed the design of its debut hardware product, the ISHO Ring. Available in gold, black, and silver, the smart ring will officially launch at the company’s inaugural AI Sleep Technology Ecosystem event on October 29 at 19:00.

Crafted from aviation-grade titanium alloy, the ring features a seamless, monochrome design across both its inner and outer surfaces. It incorporates sapphire glass on top to balance health-monitoring functionality with a sleek, jewelry-like aesthetic. Official images show multiple sensor windows embedded along the inner band.

Positioned squarely in the sleep wellness sector, Jinri Yixiu aims to build an integrated health platform connecting sensing, data analysis, actionable recommendations, and multi-device ecosystem synergy.

title_zh: 张雪称首款电摩将于 2027 年上市，主打轻量化与高能效
content_zh:
张雪机车创始人张雪在央视财经《光华录》专访中透露，旗下首款电动摩托车计划于 2027 年上市，主打轻量化、强动力和高能效，目标瞄准全球头部水平。

张雪认为，两轮电动化可以利用新能源汽车已经铺设的充电基础设施，借助汽车产业发展的补能条件进入市场。界面新闻报道，目前张雪机车小程序在售的 10 款车型均为燃油摩托车，覆盖旅行、跑车、街车、巡航和越野等类型。

电摩研发此前已有披露。今年 5 月，张雪曾表示，一款直径约 200 毫米、重 8 公斤的电机接近开发成功，可输出 50 千瓦功率。新能安此前也向界面新闻确认，与张雪机车初步接洽电摩合作。新能安是宁德时代与 ATL 合资设立的锂电池企业。

此次采访进一步明确了首款电摩的上市年份；此前展示的电机开发数据属于研发进展，尚不能等同于量产整车配置。
title_en: Zhang Xue Motorcycle Targets 2027 Launch for High-Efficiency Electric Model
content_en:
Zhang Xue, founder of Zhang Xue Motorcycle, revealed in a CCTV interview that the company's first electric motorcycle is scheduled to hit the market in 2027. Aiming to compete with top global brands, the upcoming model will focus on lightweight construction, strong power, and high energy efficiency.

Zhang noted that two-wheeled electric mobility can leverage the rapidly growing charging infrastructure built for electric cars. The brand currently offers 10 gas-powered models across touring, sport, street, cruiser, and off-road segments.

The startup has already made progress in electric drivetrain development. In May, Zhang announced the near-completion of a lightweight 8 kg, 200 mm-diameter motor capable of delivering 50 kW of output. Additionally, battery manufacturer Ampace—a joint venture between CATL and ATL—confirmed preliminary discussions with Zhang Xue Motorcycle regarding potential power system collaboration.

title_zh: 一加 Ace 7 公布双路出风设计，一路吹芯片、一路吹后盖
content_zh:
一加中国区总裁李杰 10 月 20 日公布 Ace 7 系列的主动散热设计：一个风扇提供两路出风，一路为芯片散热，另一路吹向后盖。李杰称，这套双路方案由一加首创。

这次调整主要围绕横屏游戏时的握持展开。进风口避开手指容易遮挡的位置，热风向上排出，减少直接吹手；另一股冷风经过后盖，降低手部闷热与出汗带来的影响。

李杰还在原帖回复中表示，本周末可在线下门店体验真机。
title_en: OnePlus Ace 7 Features Industry-First Dual-Channel Active Cooling System
content_en:
Louis Li, President of OnePlus China, revealed an innovative active cooling architecture for the upcoming OnePlus Ace 7 series. The system uses a single fan to drive two separate airflow pathways—one cooling the processor and the other directed at the back cover. According to Li, this dual-channel configuration is an industry first.

The layout is engineered specifically to enhance comfort during landscape gaming. Air intakes are placed away from where fingers normally rest, while hot exhaust vents upward. Meanwhile, the secondary cool airflow passes over the back cover to minimize heat buildup and prevent sweaty hands.

Li also confirmed that live demo units will be available for hands-on experience at offline retail stores starting this weekend.

title_zh: DeepSeek 开源推理框架，披露每卡每小时收入 38 美元
content_zh:
DeepSeek 10 月 20 日开源内部推理框架 DeepInfer。据官方技术报告，单一集群每天服务吞吐达 155 万亿 Tokens，按谷价计算，整体收入为每卡每小时 38 美元。

官方仓库显示，开放版本支持分布式推理、推测解码、异步调度和结构化输出，可在英伟达 SM100 GPU 与华为昇腾 950 NPU 上运行。同步开放的 deepseek-recipe 则负责请求格式转换、Token 编解码和输出解析，与官方 API 的处理逻辑对齐。
title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources 'DeepInfer' Framework, Revealing $38/GPU/Hour Revenue
content_en:
Chinese AI lab DeepSeek has officially open-sourced its internal inference framework, DeepInfer. According to the team's technical report, a single cluster running the framework can reach a daily throughput of 155 trillion tokens, generating an estimated revenue of $38 per GPU per hour based on off-peak pricing.

The repository highlights key features including distributed inference, speculative decoding, asynchronous scheduling, and structured outputs. DeepInfer supports cross-hardware deployment across both Nvidia SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs.

In tandem with the framework, DeepSeek released `deepseek-recipe`, a companion tool aligned with its official API processing logic to streamline request formatting, token encoding/decoding, and output parsing.

title_zh: 理想发布「连山」三电体系，自研电池质量问题致自燃报废可赔新车
content_zh: 理想汽车在 10 月 20 日的 Power Day 发布会上公布「连山」电动技术体系，覆盖自研电池、电驱和充电网络，并推出两项电池终身保障。据车东西现场报道，保障条件区分了电池本身质量问题与外部碰撞。
title_en: Li Auto Unveils 'Lianshan' EV Tech, Guarantees Free Car Replacement for Battery Defects
content_en:
Li Auto introduced its proprietary "Lianshan" EV tech ecosystem at its annual Power Day event, covering self-developed batteries, electric drive systems, and charging infrastructure.

To boost consumer confidence, the company announced two lifetime battery guarantee programs. Under the new policy, Li Auto promises a full replacement with a brand-new vehicle if a car catches fire or is scrapped due to self-developed battery quality defects, drawing a clear distinction between internal manufacturing flaws and external collision damage.

title_zh: 腾讯内测「懂了鸭」，用 AI 创作绘本、动画和互动课件
content_zh:
腾讯正在内测 AI 趣味学习社区「懂了鸭」。其官网将产品定位为互动内容社区，用户可发现学习内容，也可用 AI 把想法制作成绘本、动画、动态课件和知识游戏，再分享给其他人。

据「产品笔记」体验，社区内容覆盖学前至 K12 阶段。家长、老师及创作者输入主题后，Agent 会拆解创作步骤；以绘本为例，流程包括确认主角、确认示例、绘制全本和整理成册，用户可在过程中调整方向并实时预览。

平台支持将公开作品组织为合集，也允许在授权范围内改编已有作品。创作者还可上传 HTML，或通过外部 Agent 按懂了鸭的格式整理后导入作品，发布时可设置是否允许下载、改编。

内测版本提供网页与小程序两种形态。原文还展示了可引用的学科知识树和模型选择功能，用于辅助创作；这些机制并不代表生成的教育内容已经得到准确性保证。
title_en: Tencent Betas 'Dong Le Ya', an AI Platform for Storybooks and Interactive Courseware
content_en:
Tencent is currently beta-testing an AI-powered educational community called "Dong Le Ya" (Got It Duck). Designed for interactive content creation, the platform allows parents, educators, and creators to transform ideas into picture books, animations, dynamic courseware, and knowledge games targeting K-12 and pre-school audiences.

Powered by specialized AI agents, the platform breaks creation into guided steps. For picture books, the workflow handles character selection, sample verification, page generation, and compilation, with real-time adjustments available throughout the process.

"Dong Le Ya" supports content remixing, topic collections, and custom file imports via HTML. Creators can also configure download and adaptation permissions for their published works. The platform is currently available via web browsers and WeChat Mini Programs.

title_zh: ChatGPT 推出对话锁，支持 PIN 与生物识别解锁
content_zh:
ChatGPT 开始逐步推出 Locked Chats 功能，用户可为保存的对话上锁，以四位账户 PIN 访问；支持的移动设备也可使用 Face ID、Touch ID 或设备解锁方式。

上锁后，对话会移至「Projects > Locked chats」，从常规历史、置顶和普通对话搜索中隐藏。它仍会保存，用户可再次打开；这与不会进入历史记录的临时对话不同。

OpenAI 强调，对话锁不会创建端到端加密或独立加密保险库，也不改变保留期限及「为所有人改进模型」设置。启用记忆时，上锁后的新消息可用于其他锁定对话的记忆，但不会更新常规记忆；上锁前已经记住的信息不会因此移除。

忘记 PIN 后若选择重置，会永久删除受旧 PIN 保护的锁定对话、相关记忆与文件。该功能覆盖 Free、Go、Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 和 Edu，医疗版暂不支持。
title_en: OpenAI Rolls Out 'Locked Chats' for ChatGPT with PIN and Biometric Protection
content_en:
OpenAI has begun rolling out a new "Locked Chats" feature for ChatGPT, allowing users to secure specific conversations behind a 4-digit account PIN or mobile biometrics such as Face ID and Touch ID. Once locked, conversations are moved to "Projects > Locked chats" and hidden from main chat histories, search results, and pinned items.

OpenAI highlighted that this feature does not provide end-to-end encryption or a separate security vault, nor does it alter data retention rules or model training preferences. Memories generated within locked chats remain isolated from standard chat histories. However, users should exercise caution, as resetting a forgotten PIN will result in the permanent deletion of all associated locked conversations, memories, and files.

The feature is being made available across most account tiers—including Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu—with the exception of healthcare plans.

title_zh: MemT 1.0 开源，让模型在内部记忆中保留和调用经验
content_zh:
记忆张量发布并开源记忆原生基础模型 MemT 1.0 系列，包含 Flash 和 Nano 两款模型，总参数分别为 288B、36B，激活参数分别为 17B、3B。模型权重与推理代码已通过 Hugging Face、GitHub 提供。

MemT 1.0 在 Transformer 中加入原生记忆模块，让记忆注意力与原有注意力并行运行。生成回答时，模型读取已有记忆；一轮交互结束后，再把输入与回答写入独立的动态记忆状态，供后续任务使用。在线交互期间，模型主干及超记忆权重保持固定，变化的是每条交互轨迹的记忆状态。

据团队评测，两款模型在 11 项记忆基准上平均得分分别为 50.6 和 47.0，测试时不在查询上下文中提供历史原文；排名范围为本次评估的参数化记忆方法，文本记忆系统在长历史检索上仍有整体优势。

团队也指出，固定容量记忆需要在保留早期细节与接纳新信息之间权衡，当前编程经验应用仍依赖外部经验库和检索，尚未形成自主获取、验证并持续整合经验的完整闭环。
title_en: MemT 1.0 Open-Sourced: Empowering LLMs with Native Dynamic Memory
content_en:
AI research group Memory Tensor has open-sourced the MemT 1.0 model series, featuring the Flash (288B total / 17B active parameters) and Nano (36B total / 3B active parameters) models. The model weights and inference code are now publicly available on Hugging Face and GitHub.

MemT 1.0 introduces a native memory module directly into the Transformer architecture, running memory attention in parallel with regular attention. During multi-turn interactions, inputs and answers are dynamically stored into a dedicated memory state without altering base model weights, allowing the model to recall past experiences in future tasks without context clutter.

While MemT performed strongly across 11 memory benchmarks, developers noted that fixed-capacity memory requires a trade-off between retaining past context and absorbing new information, with complex tasks like coding still reliant on external retrieval systems.

title_zh: 影翎 A1 更新：新增 4G 图传与绕行避障
content_zh:
影翎 AG 于 10 月 20 日发布 A1 无人机秋季更新，推出经典双摇杆遥控器与 4G 图传增强模块，并通过固件升级新增绕行避障和定速飞行功能。

经典遥控器采用双摇杆、按键与拨轮设计，面向需要更精细控制飞行轨迹和镜头运动的创作者。配合 Vision 飞行眼镜，用户可以在固定视角与自由视角之间切换。

4G 图传增强模块内置 eSIM，可与 OmniLink 360 原生图传协同工作。模块默认安装于无人机端，飞行眼镜端也提供专属选装图传模块。

此次固件升级还为 A1 增加了绕行避障和定速飞行能力。售价方面，影翎 A1 经典遥控器套装原价 8499 元，双十一促销价为 7299 元；4G 图传增强模块原价 699 元，限时促销价为 559 元。
title_en: Yingling A1 Drone Receives Autumn Update with 4G Transmission and Bypass Obstacle Avoidance
content_en:
Yingling AG has announced its autumn update for the A1 drone, introducing a classic dual-joystick remote controller, a 4G image transmission module, and firmware upgrades that add bypass obstacle avoidance and cruise control.

The classic dual-joystick controller is designed for creators requiring finer control over flight trajectories and camera angles, working seamlessly alongside Vision goggles. Meanwhile, the new 4G enhancement module incorporates an eSIM that operates in tandem with the native OmniLink 360 system for improved link reliability.

The Yingling A1 classic controller bundle is priced at 8,499 RMB (discounted to 7,299 RMB for Double 11), while the 4G video transmission module is available for 699 RMB (limited-time price of 559 RMB).

title_zh: 元宝搜索通过腾讯云对外开放，支持 API、MCP 和 Skill 接入
content_zh:
腾讯宣布，元宝搜索 10 月 20 日正式通过腾讯云对外开放，面向大模型和 Agent 提供联网搜索能力。该服务整合全网公开资源与腾讯内容生态，开发者可通过 API、MCP 和 Skill 三种方式接入。

据腾讯云介绍，元宝搜索已形成千亿级索引，日均调用量达数亿次，支撑 WorkBuddy、ima、腾讯金融科技、腾讯视频等 50 多个腾讯业务。服务可理解口语化查询、多语种混用及名称歧义，并依据相关性、时效性和权威性对结果排序。

腾讯云产品页显示，服务支持指定网址、时间范围与垂直领域检索，可返回摘要、图片列表及相关性信息。政策、新闻、天气和行情等内容支持分钟级更新；官方将信息去噪和供模型直接使用，列为降低后续处理成本的主要方向。
title_en: Tencent Cloud Launches Yuanbao Search API for AI Models and Agents
content_en:
Tencent has officially made its Yuanbao Search service available to external developers via Tencent Cloud. Designed to provide real-time web search capabilities for large language models (LLMs) and AI agents, the service combines open web resources with Tencent's proprietary content ecosystem. Developers can integrate the service using API, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or Skill interfaces.

Yuanbao Search currently indexes hundreds of billions of web pages and processes hundreds of millions of daily queries across more than 50 Tencent business lines. The search engine is optimized to handle natural language queries, mixed-language inputs, and entity disambiguation, ranking results based on relevance, timeliness, and source authority.

The service offers targeted search controls, including site-specific domain filtering, custom date ranges, and minute-level updates for time-sensitive content such as news, weather, and financial data. By delivering clean, noise-filtered data ready for immediate AI model consumption, Tencent aims to help developers significantly lower downstream processing costs.

title_zh: 麦当劳发布「薯标」
content_zh:
麦当劳中国 10 月 20 日宣布，「重塑好物」薯条款鼠标套装将于 10 月 22、23 日 10:45 起在麦麦商城发售，每日各限量 2000 套。

官方海报中的鼠标采用红色薯条盒搭配金黄色薯条的造型，配有红色滚轮，套装还展示了一只印有薯条图案的收纳包。麦当劳称，这款「薯标」由回收的开心乐园餐旧玩具再生制成。

这项产品来自麦当劳中国与联想集团的合作。今年 6 月的官方新闻稿介绍，开心乐园餐旧玩具经过分类回收后，进入联想绿色供应链，完成拆解、材料再生及专业加工，转化为可用于生产的新材料。

麦当劳于 2021 年启动「重塑好物」循环再生计划，此前已推出绿色餐盘、环保充电单车、开心花盆等再生产品。这次公布的是薯标套装在麦麦商城的具体发售安排。
title_en: McDonald's China Unveils Computer Mouse Crafted from Recycled Toys
content_en:
McDonald's China has announced the release of a French fry-themed computer mouse set under its "Upcycling Goodies" sustainability initiative. Styled after the iconic red fry box filled with golden fries, the limited-edition package includes a matching storage pouch and will be available exclusively via the official app store on October 22 and 23, with daily sales capped at 2,000 units.

The collectible peripheral is constructed from recycled plastic sourced from returned Happy Meal toys. The initiative was developed in collaboration with Lenovo Group, leveraging Lenovo's green supply chain to sort, disassemble, and reprocess discarded plastic into high-grade manufacturing material.

Since launching the "Upcycling Goodies" circular economy campaign in 2021, McDonald's China has introduced several eco-friendly products made from recycled materials, including serving trays, stationary bikes, and plant pots.

title_zh: lululemon 在上海联动场馆，推出 8 天「一起好状态」热汗课程
content_zh:
lululemon 开启「一起好状态」系列活动，在上海联合多家场馆推出为期 8 天的主题热汗课程，并在全国门店发起不同类型的运动课程。

活动涵盖瑜伽、普拉提、力量训练和身体恢复，也包括品牌大使 MoMo.V 带来的全能 Tabata 课。品牌希望通过场馆与社区伙伴合作，将课程带进不同运动空间。
title_en: lululemon Rolls Out 8-Day Fitness Campaign Across Shanghai Venues
content_en:
lululemon has launched an eight-day community workout series in Shanghai as part of its nationwide "Find Your Wellbeing" initiative. In partnership with local fitness studios and community spaces, the brand is hosting a variety of themed sweat sessions alongside workouts at its retail locations across China.

The curated schedule spans yoga, Pilates, strength training, and recovery sessions. Highlights include a comprehensive Tabata masterclass led by lululemon brand ambassador MoMo.V.

Through these venue partnerships, lululemon aims to deepen ties with local fitness communities and encourage wellness engagement across diverse athletic spaces.

title_zh: 宋佳、文淇主演《我们仅有一次的人生》定档 11 月 7 日
content_zh:
电影《我们仅有一次的人生》（原名《余烬》）宣布将于 11 月 7 日上映，并发布定档海报和预告。影片由孙傲谦编剧、执导，宋佳、文淇、祖峰领衔主演。

故事围绕黄燕与姚雪展开：宋佳饰演的黄燕在日常火化工作中逐渐失去对生活的期待，因一场意外，与刚刚失去母亲的姚雪相遇，后者由文淇饰演。两个孤独的人在冬季逐渐靠近，重新理解彼此与生活。
title_en: Song Jia and Wen Qi Star in 'Life Only Once', Set for November 7 Release
content_en:
The upcoming drama *Life Only Once* (formerly titled *Embers*) is scheduled to hit theaters on November 7, accompanied by the release of its official poster and trailer. Written and directed by Sun Aoqian, the film stars Song Jia, Wen Qi, and Zu Feng.

The narrative centers on Huang Yan (Song Jia), a crematorium worker who has gradually lost her zest for life. Her path crosses unexpectedly with Yao Xue (Wen Qi), a young woman grieving the loss of her mother. As winter unfolds, the two lonely individuals bond, discovering solace and a fresh perspective on life.

title_zh: 《戴帽子的猫》发布新预告，11 月 6 日内地、北美同步上映
content_zh:
华纳兄弟动画电影《戴帽子的猫》发布新预告，宣布将于 11 月 6 日在中国内地与北美同步上映。影片改编自苏斯博士的经典童书。

预告中，戴着红白条纹高帽的猫把沙发变成交通工具，让玩具成为冒险伙伴，以天马行空的想象为孩子驱散烦恼。影片由《我的世界大电影》幕后团队打造。
title_en: New Trailer Released for 'The Cat in the Hat', Set for Simultaneous China and North America Release on November 6
content_en:
Warner Bros. Animation has unveiled a new trailer for *The Cat in the Hat*, confirming a day-and-date release in mainland China and North America on November 6. The animated feature is adapted from the timeless Dr. Seuss children's book.

In the trailer, the whimsical cat in his signature red-and-white striped hat turns living room sofas into high-speed vehicles and everyday toys into adventure buddies, bringing joyful imagination to children. The film is produced by the creative team behind *A Minecraft Movie*.

title_zh: Carol Choi 将接任迪士尼亚太区总裁，12 月 1 日生效
content_zh:
迪士尼 10 月 20 日宣布，现任亚太区执行副总裁 Carol Choi 将于 12 月 1 日接任亚太区总裁。现任总裁 Luke Kang 决定退休，结束在迪士尼的任职。

据 Deadline 与 The Hollywood Reporter 刊出的公司声明，Choi 将负责迪士尼娱乐在大中华区、日本、韩国、东南亚、澳大利亚和新西兰的业务，范围涵盖电影业务、Disney+、本地原创内容制作、消费品、媒体网络及内容销售。

Choi 于 2006 年加入迪士尼，曾负责日本和韩国业务，也曾在大中华区担任管理职务。她目前主管亚太区电影业务、原创内容策略及整合营销，并参与了 Disney+ 在该地区的推出与扩展。
title_en: Carol Choi Named President of Disney Asia-Pacific, Effective December 1
content_en:
Disney announced on October 20 that Executive Vice President Carol Choi will assume the role of President of Asia-Pacific (APAC) on December 1. She succeeds current president Luke Kang, who is retiring after a long tenure at the company.

According to company statements, Choi will oversee Disney Entertainment's extensive business operations across Greater China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand. Her responsibilities include theatrical distribution, Disney+, local original productions, consumer products, media networks, and content licensing.

Having joined Disney in 2006, Choi previously managed operations in Japan, Korea, and Greater China. In her current role overseeing regional theatrical business, original content strategy, and integrated marketing, she was instrumental in the regional launch and expansion of Disney+.
